Class Controller

java.lang.Object
Presentation.Controller
public class Controller extends Object
Controls the execution of the Olympic Games application. Handles user menu selections and coordinates interactions between the user interface and the business logic.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Starts the application and manages the main menu. Executes the selected options and handles exceptions that may occur during program execution.

    • manageDelegations

      private void manageDelegations() throws IOException
      Displays and manages the delegations submenu. Allows the user to list delegations, view medal counts or return to the main menu.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while accessing delegation data

    • listDelegations

      private void listDelegations() throws IOException
      Displays the list of delegations and allows the user to select one to view its information and athletes.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading delegation or athlete data

    • showMedals

      private void showMedals() throws IOException
      Displays the medal table of all delegations, sorted by the number of medals won.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading delegation data

    • manageAthletes

      private void manageAthletes() throws IOException
      Displays and manages the athletes submenu. Allows the user to register, list and search athletes.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while accessing athlete data

    • registerAthlete

      private void registerAthlete() throws IOException
      Registers a new athlete using data provided by the user. Displays the registered athlete without passing entity objects to Presentation.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the athlete or delegation files cannot be accessed

    • manageCompetitions

      private void manageCompetitions() throws IOException
      Displays and manages the competitions submenu. Allows the user to load, list and delete competitions, or return to the main menu.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while accessing competition data

    • loadCompetitions

      private void loadCompetitions() throws IOException
      Loads competitions from a CSV file. Reads the file, validates the competition data and displays the import results and any detected errors.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading or saving the data

    • listCompetitions

      private void listCompetitions() throws IOException
      Displays the list of available competitions and allows the user to select one to view its detailed information and participating athletes.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading competition or athlete data

    • deleteCompetition

      private void deleteCompetition() throws IOException
      Allows the user to select and delete a competition. Displays its details, requests confirmation and removes it from the system if the user confirms the operation.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading or saving competition data

    • simulateOlympicGames

      private void simulateOlympicGames() throws IOException
      Simulates all available Olympic competitions. Skips competitions with fewer than three athletes. Displays the results, saves them to persistence and updates the delegation medal counts.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading or saving the data
      IllegalStateException - if the simulation contains invalid data
